notes: Physical I/O verified against Zoom's own online Operation Manual ("Names of Parts" chapter, https://zoomcorp.com/manuals/f8n_pro-en) and cross-checked against Sweetwater's and other retailers' spec tables (which independently confirm "TA3" main outs, BNC timecode I/O, and Mini-B USB). Not a rack-mount device (handheld field recorder), so rackUnits is omitted. Two ports could not be exactly represented by the given connector enum: (1) the rear "MIC IN" jack is Zoom's proprietary multi-pin connector for detachable mic capsules (e.g. MSH-6/XYH-6) and has no standard equivalent in the list, so it was omitted entirely; (2) the two MAIN OUT jacks use TA3 (mini-XLR3), mapped to "xlr3" as the nearest listed type; (3) EXT DC IN uses a Hirose HR10 4-pin locking DC connector, mapped to "xlr4-dc" as the nearest listed DC-power type even though it is not physically an XLR shell. Region/package variants (e.g. bundled AD-19 adapter plug type) may differ by market but do not affect the recorder's own port set.
